nodes.label: Fail-closed whole masking of images/canvas/iframes
nodes.rationale: By design in Phase 1: every image, canvas, video and iframe is masked whole until Phase 2 detectors can mask precisely.

nodes.label: Split along the privacy line (browser sees/censors, server reasons)
nodes.norm_label: split along the privacy line (browser sees/censors, server reasons)
nodes.rationale: Screens are dense with PII so raw screenshots cannot go to the cloud; small local models can see and redact but cannot plan, so planning stays server-side over a sanitized description.
nodes.source_file: VEIL_ PRD, TRD and System Architecture.html

nodes.label: DistilBERT NER via Transformers.js
